projects.name: AR Aging Dashboard
details: AR Aging Dashboard
• Objective: To design an AR (Accounts Receivable) aging dashboard that tracks key metrics, including trends, deductions, collections, and unapplied
cash, while identifying overdue accounts and payment patterns to improve cash flow.
• Technologies: Python (Pandas, Matplotlib), SQL, Power BI.
• Results: Reduced 30-day and above due accounts by 30% within six months. Developed detailed client payment profiles to analyze and predict
payment patterns from customer invoices. Improved overall cash flow by 20% through enhanced payment collection strategies.
